name: wikitext2raw_benchmark_roya
description: A dataset derived from the WikiText-2 corpus intended to evaluate language models on raw Wikitext reconstruction and next-token prediction behavior. It provides inputs representing raw wiki text formats and is useful for benchmarking LM generative fidelity and token-level modeling performance. Typical use is measuring language-model perplexity or reconstruction accuracy on wiki-style content.
reputation: A small, specialized dataset variant used mainly by practitioners working on language-model preprocessing and evaluation; limited broad community adoption.
